items.source: Setting a custom-configured ObjectMapper is one way to take further control of the JSON serialization process. For example, an extended SerializerFactory can be configured that provides custom serializers for specific types. The other option for refining the serialization process is to use Jackson's provided annotations on the types to be serialized, in which case a custom-configured ObjectMapper is unnecessary.
items.translation: 配置自定义的 ObjectMapper 是进一步控制 JSON 序列化过程的一种方式。例如，可以配置扩展的 SerializerFactory，为特定类型提供自定义序列化器。另一种细化序列化过程的选项是在待序列化的类型上使用 Jackson 提供的注解；在这种情况下，则无需配置自定义的 ObjectMapper。

protected JavaType getJavaType(Class<?> clazz) {
        if (List.class.isAssignableFrom(clazz)) {
                return TypeFactory.defaultInstance().constructCollectionType(ArrayList.class, MyBean.class);
        } else {
                return super.getJavaType(clazz);
        }
}
items.translation:
protected JavaType getJavaType(Class<?> clazz) {
    if (List.class.isAssignableFrom(clazz)) {
        return TypeFactory.defaultInstance().constructCollectionType(ArrayList.class, MyBean.class);
    } else {
        return super.getJavaType(clazz);
    }
}
